domains.name: URL Interception & Routing
domains.description: Handles interception of clicked links and routing them through the browser selector or automatic rules engine. Integrates with Windows registry to register Switchy as a URL protocol handler.

domains.name: Browser Selection & Launching
domains.description: Core business logic for selecting and launching browsers with the current URL. Manages browser inventory, launches processes with appropriate arguments, handles alternate browser profiles and configurations.

domains.name: URL Routing Rules & Automation
domains.description: Implements automatic URL-to-browser routing based on user-defined rules. Supports pattern matching by domain, regex, string containment, and forces manual selection when needed.

domains.name: Settings & Configuration Management
domains.description: Persists and manages user configuration including browser list, rules, appearance settings, and application preferences. Provides caching and default value handling.

domains.name: Browser Detection & Inventory
domains.description: Discovers installed browsers on the system via Windows registry scanning, extracts browser metadata (icons, launch paths, profiles), and maintains the browser inventory.

domains.name: Windows System Integration
domains.description: Handles Windows-specific functionality including registry manipulation for protocol handler registration, window management, DWM backdrop effects, and system process launching.

domains.name: User Interface & Rendering
domains.description: Vue 3 frontend providing browser selector UI, settings configuration interface, and real-time theme/appearance switching. Wails bridges Go backend with web-based UI.

domains.name: Inter-Process Communication
domains.description: Enables single-instance enforcement via named pipes. Forwards URLs from new process invocations to the existing Switchy instance for seamless multi-click handling.

domains.name: Observability & Logging
domains.description: Structured logging service for debugging and operational insight. Provides leveled logging (debug, info, warn, error) with file-based output.

flows.name: URL Interception → Manual Browser Selection
flows.description: User clicks a link, Switchy intercepts it. No matching rule found or rules disabled. User sees browser picker and selects one.
flows.entry_point: User clicks http(s) link in browser, triggering registered Switchy handler
flows.exit_point: Selected browser opens with URL, Switchy exits

flows.name: URL Interception → Automatic Rule Routing
flows.description: User clicks link, Switchy intercepts it. Matching rule found and rules enabled. Browser launches automatically without UI.
flows.entry_point: User clicks http(s) link in browser, triggering registered Switchy handler
flows.exit_point: Matched browser opens with URL, Switchy exits silently

flows.name: Browser Detection & Inventory
flows.description: System scans for installed browsers, extracts metadata, builds inventory with icons and launch configurations. Triggered on startup or manual refresh.
flows.entry_point: App startup or user triggers 'Detect Browsers' action
flows.exit_point: Browser list saved to configuration, available for selection

flows.name: Settings Configuration & Persistence
flows.description: User opens Settings UI, modifies rules, browser visibility, appearance, and saves. Configuration persisted to disk with validation.
flows.entry_point: User opens Settings window (--settings flag or from selector)
flows.exit_point: Configuration persisted, changes take effect on next URL

flows.name: Registration as Default URL Handler
flows.description: Admin operation to register Switchy as the system's http/https protocol handler. Modifies Windows registry to route clicked links through Switchy.
flows.exit_point: Windows Settings opens for user confirmation

flows.name: Unregistration as Default URL Handler
flows.description: Admin operation to remove Switchy from system URL protocol handling. Cleans up Windows registry entries.
flows.exit_point: Registry cleaned, Switchy no longer handles links

flows.name: Single Instance Enforcement
flows.description: When user clicks a link and another Switchy instance is already running, the new invocation forwards the URL to existing instance and exits.
flows.entry_point: User clicks link while Switchy selector already open
flows.exit_point: URL added to existing selector, second process exits

flows.name: Alternate Browser Launch Profile
flows.description: User selects an alternate launch configuration for a browser (e.g., Private/Incognito mode). Browser launches with profile-specific arguments.
flows.entry_point: User selects alternate profile option in browser selector UI
flows.exit_point: Browser opens with alternate launch arguments (private mode, etc)

steps.name: URL Handler Invocation
steps.description: Windows registry directs clicked link to Switchy executable with URL as command-line argument
steps.input: URL string from Windows link click

steps.name: IPC Forward Attempt
steps.description: New process attempts to connect to named pipe and forward URL to existing instance
steps.output: Boolean success flag (true = forwarded, false = no existing instance)

steps.name: Automatic Rule Matching
steps.description: System evaluates all enabled rules against the URL using pattern matching (domain, regex, string match). Returns matching browser name or empty string.
steps.input: URL string, Ruleset array from configuration
steps.output: Browser name string, empty string, or ForcePickerBrowser sentinel

steps.name: Browser Match Resolution
steps.description: Rule match result indicates specific browser should launch. Browser config looked up and prepared for launching.
steps.output: Browser configuration object ready for launch

steps.name: Selector UI Display
steps.description: Wails application launches with selector UI. Loads settings and browser list from backend, renders Vue selector component.
steps.input: URL to display, App mode, Wails context
steps.output: Running Wails window with Vue selector UI

steps.name: Browser Selection UI Interaction
steps.description: User sees list of browsers, selects one via mouse click or keyboard shortcut (1-9). Frontend emits event to backend.
steps.input: User interaction (click or key press), browser list from backend
steps.output: Browser selection event with browser name

steps.name: Browser Process Launch
steps.description: Selected browser executable launched with URL and configured launch arguments. For UWP apps, routes through explorer.exe.

steps.name: Switchy Exit
steps.description: Switchy application terminates after browser launch or error. Selector window closes.
steps.input: Browser launch completion or error state

steps.name: Windows Registry Scan
steps.description: Scans HKLM and HKCU registry hives under SOFTWARE\Clients\StartMenuInternet to find installed browsers.
steps.output: List of browser registry entry names

steps.name: Browser Metadata Extraction
steps.description: For each detected browser, reads registry to extract display name, executable path, and icon specification.
steps.output: Browser config object with name, exePath, iconSpec

steps.name: Chromium Profile Detection
steps.description: For Chromium-based browsers (Chrome, Edge, Brave), detects individual user profiles and creates profile-specific browser entries.

steps.name: Browser Icon Extraction
steps.description: Extracts icon from browser executable file using Windows API calls. Returns base64-encoded PNG for UI display.
steps.input: Browser executable path, optional pixel size

steps.name: Browser Deduplication
steps.description: Removes duplicate browser entries (same name+exe) found in multiple registry locations. Preserves Chrome profiles with distinct names.
steps.input: Full browser list from registry scan

steps.name: Inventory Caching
steps.description: Detected browser list is saved to configuration file and cached in memory for fast retrieval during URL selection.
steps.output: Persisted config file with browser list

steps.name: Settings UI Load
steps.description: Wails application launches in settings mode. Loads current configuration from disk. Frontend renders SettingsView component.
steps.output: Running Wails window with settings UI

steps.name: Configuration Load
steps.description: Current configuration (browsers, rules, settings) loaded from disk JSON file. Defaults applied if file missing.

steps.name: Settings Display
steps.description: Settings UI renders current configuration values including rules, browser visibility toggles, appearance settings, etc.
steps.output: Settings form populated with current values

steps.name: User Edit Rules
steps.description: User modifies rules in settings UI - adds, removes, or edits pattern-to-browser mappings. Changes reflected in UI immediately.
steps.output: Modified ruleset array in UI state

steps.name: User Edit Appearance
steps.description: User changes theme, appearance (Acrylic/Mica), selector layout, and other visual preferences.

steps.name: Configuration Save
steps.description: Modified configuration serialized to JSON and written to disk. All user changes persisted.

steps.name: Write Registry Client Entry
steps.description: Creates HKLM SOFTWARE\Clients\StartMenuInternet\Switchy registry key with client name.

steps.name: Write Registry ProgID Entry
steps.description: Creates HKLM SOFTWARE\Classes\SwitchyHTML registry key pointing to Switchy executable for URL handling.

steps.name: Write Registry Capabilities Entry
steps.description: Creates Capabilities registry key with application description and name for Windows Default Apps.

steps.name: Write Registry URL Associations
steps.description: Registers http and https protocols to route through SwitchyHTML ProgID in registry.

steps.name: Write Registry Shell Command Entry
steps.description: Registers shell\open\command in registry to invoke Switchy.exe with URL placeholder.

steps.name: Write Registry Application Entry
steps.description: Adds Switchy to Windows RegisteredApplications registry for visibility in Settings.

steps.name: Open Default Apps Settings
steps.description: Launches Windows Settings Default Apps page to allow user to confirm Switchy as default handler.

steps.name: Registry Cleanup: URL Associations
steps.description: Deletes URLAssociations registry key to remove http/https associations.

steps.name: Registry Cleanup: Capabilities
steps.description: Deletes Capabilities registry key and children.

steps.name: Registry Cleanup: Shell Commands
steps.description: Deletes shell\open\command and parent keys from registry.

steps.name: Registry Cleanup: Client Entry
steps.description: Deletes Switchy client registry entry from StartMenuInternet.

steps.name: Registry Cleanup: ProgID Entry
steps.description: Deletes SwitchyHTML ProgID registry entry from Classes.

steps.name: Registry Cleanup: Registered Applications
steps.description: Removes Switchy from RegisteredApplications registry list.

steps.name: Second Process Spawned
steps.description: User clicks link while Switchy already running. Windows registry spawns new Switchy.exe process with URL argument.
steps.input: User link click, existing Switchy process running
steps.output: New Switchy process with URL argument

steps.name: IPC Connection Attempt
steps.description: New process attempts to connect to named pipe \\\\?pipe\\SwitchyPipe with 2-second timeout.

steps.name: URL Message Encoding
steps.description: URL wrapped in JSON Message struct and encoded for transmission over named pipe.

steps.name: IPC URL Forward
steps.description: Encoded URL message transmitted through named pipe to listening process.

steps.name: First Process Receives Message
steps.description: Original Switchy instance listening on named pipe receives URL message from new process.
steps.input: Incoming pipe connection with message data

steps.name: First Process Updates URL
steps.description: Running Switchy instance receives forwarded URL, updates internal URL state, and triggers UI event to display new URL in selector.
steps.output: Internal URL state updated, UI event emitted

steps.name: Second Process Exits
steps.description: New process exits after successful URL forward, main.go returns early.

steps.name: Alternate Profile Selection
steps.description: User selects an alternate launch profile option (e.g., 'Private Window') from browser button context menu in UI.
steps.input: User interaction (context menu or button secondary click)
steps.output: Alternate selection event with browser name and profile name

steps.name: Alternate Config Lookup
steps.description: Backend searches browser's AlternateLaunches array for matching alternate launch configuration by name.

steps.name: Alternate Arguments Build
steps.description: Launch arguments from alternate configuration combined with URL to create process command line.

steps.name: Browser Launch with Alternate Profile
steps.description: Browser executable launched with alternate arguments (e.g., --private-window, --new-private-window for different browsers).
steps.input: Browser executable path, alternate arguments, URL
steps.output: Running browser process in alternate mode

entry_points.name: Windows Link Click
entry_points.description: User clicks http(s) link in any Windows application. Windows registry routes to Switchy executable via registered protocol handler.
entry_points.trigger: User action - click link in browser, email client, document, etc.
entry_points.handler: file:main.go - main() function routes to runSelector() with URL argument

entry_points.name: Settings Window Launch
entry_points.description: Switchy launched with --settings flag to open configuration UI.
entry_points.trigger: User action - click 'Settings' button in selector or direct execution
entry_points.handler: file:main.go - main() function detects flag and calls runSettings()

entry_points.name: Registration Operation
entry_points.description: Switchy launched with --register flag to register as default URL handler.
entry_points.trigger: User action - 'Install as Default Browser' in installer or manual command
entry_points.handler: file:main.go - main() function detects flag and calls handleRegister()

entry_points.name: Unregistration Operation
entry_points.description: Switchy launched with --unregister flag to remove from default URL handler.
entry_points.handler: file:main.go - main() function detects flag and calls handleUnregister()

entry_points.name: IPC URL Forward Message
entry_points.description: Existing Switchy instance receives forwarded URL from new process via named pipe.
entry_points.trigger: New process invocation of Switchy while instance already running
